newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait panel reviews power rates for projects.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait panel reviews power rates for projects.

text.p: A Kuwaiti panel has been asked to decide on a formula for power rates for several multi-billion-dollar proposed industrial projects in the Gulf state, industry executives said on Tuesday.

"The government has asked the industrial authority to resolve this issue over the next couple of weeks" one executive told Reuters. "There are two to four serious projects which need a final decision on the power."
Kuwait has plans to build several power hungry industrial projects but executives say lack of a decision on state supplied power rates have delayed implementation.
They say the oil-rich state should offer investors attractive power prices to start projects in Kuwait rather than in other Gulf Arab states with competitive prices.
The projects include plans for several steel plants and a $1 billion aluminium smelter which the Kuwait-based National Industries is seeking a stake in along with Raytheon Co of the United States.
